definitions.return_std_24: rolling24 sample standard deviation of hourly simple returns, ddof=1
definitions.return_std_168: rolling168 sample standard deviation of hourly simple returns, ddof=1
definitions.volatility_percentile_720: fraction of last720 NATR14 values <= current NATR14; includes current, no global fit
definitions.regime_duration: consecutive candles with current Phase2B regime, including current
definitions.regime_transition: 1 if current Phase2B regime differs from previous candle, else 0
definitions.hour_of_day: UTC hour of decision time (candle open + 1h)
definitions.day_of_week: UTC weekday of decision time, Monday=0
definitions.candles_since_prior_signal: candles since last SMA20/50 upward crossover strictly before current candle; no prior -> missing
definitions.source_synthetic: 1 if decision candle was known gap filled with past close / zero volume
definitions.regime: unchanged Phase2B causal label at decision candle close
definitions.volatility_ratio_24_168: rolling24 std(hourly returns)/rolling168 std; zero denominator ->0
definitions.natr_ratio_168: current NATR14/rolling168 mean NATR14; relative volatility level
definitions.up_fraction_24: fraction of last24 close differences strictly positive; directional persistence
definitions.signal_density_168: count of baseline upward SMA crosses in last168 candles /168; includes current signal

removed_from_phase2c.body_ratio: Near duplicate of return_1h; hourly open approximately previous close.
removed_from_phase2c.atr14: Use normalized ATR instead of price-scale-dependent raw ATR.
removed_from_phase2c.macd_hist_ratio: Exact difference of macd_ratio and macd_signal_ratio.

additions.volatility_ratio_24_168: rolling24 std(hourly returns)/rolling168 std; zero denominator ->0
additions.natr_ratio_168: current NATR14/rolling168 mean NATR14; relative volatility level
additions.up_fraction_24: fraction of last24 close differences strictly positive; directional persistence
additions.signal_density_168: count of baseline upward SMA crosses in last168 candles /168; includes current signal

rules: No forward return, outcome end, year, row_id, duration, profit, exit or label interval is a predictor. Pair/regime categorical. Future horizon returns labels only.
